title: Level 4 Containment
description: A woman in an orange jumpsuit climbs a metal staircase while carrying a glowing device, surrounded by flooded industrial ruins. The scene features a large colorful mural of classical figures on the decaying wall, floating film reels, a submerged red armchair, and a glowing red sign reading 'LEVEL 4 - CONTAINMENT'.
prompt: A lone woman in an orange prison jumpsuit ascends a flooded metal staircase inside a decaying industrial containment facility, carrying a glowing teal device. A massive colorful classical mural with angels and figures covers the crumbling wall behind her. Dark water fills the lower level with a red armchair and scattered film reels floating. Red neon sign reads LEVEL 4 - CONTAINMENT. Cinematic lighting, atmospheric and moody, detailed digital painting.
